management_remarks: Reliance Industries delivered solid consolidated operating results in Q1 FY25 led by Jio Digital Services subscriber additions and industry-leading data traffic growth of 32% year-on-year. Jio's 5G network deployment is now the largest outside China, driving strong home broadband and enterprise digital adoption across India. Oil & Gas upstream EBITDA expanded 28% year-on-year on higher KG-D6 gas production, reinforcing strong consolidated cash flow generation.
analyst_qa: In the Q&A on O2C margins, management noted that global refining cracks and petrochemical spreads remain volatile due to excess Chinese capacity and uncertain export demand. In Reliance Retail, we are taking a calibrated and cautious approach to physical store additions while rationalizing underperforming small-format outlets amid challenging discretionary spend. Near-term capex phasing in New Energy remains subject to global equipment supply chains and moderating downstream chemical margins.
